title: Told to get back to blowing up fuel tanks, David Warren built the black box anyway

posts.facebook:
A pocket dictation machine, a run of jet crashes and a boss who said no. How the black box flight recorder began in Melbourne.

How David Warren of Australia's Aeronautical Research Laboratories came up with the cockpit recorder after the Comet crashes, why it was rejected at home, how a British visitor changed that, and where the accounts disagree.

A good idea can wait years for the one person who sees what it is for, so keep it ready to show.

Read the full story → https://dontdieretired.com/curious/david-warren-black-box-flight-recorder/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=daily
